configurations.name: server-library
runtimeArgs: cd "$HOME/.qingyu-server" && QINGYU_WEB_PASSWORD="$(cat web-password)" QINGYU_WEB_SECURE_COOKIE=false QINGYU_WEB_DIR="$PWD/web" QINGYU_LIBRARY_DIR="$PWD/notes" QINGYU_CONFIG_DIR="$PWD/config" QINGYU_SYNC_WORKER="$PWD/sync/server-sync-worker.mjs" PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@24/bin:$PATH" QINGYU_API_ADDR=127.0.0.1:8797 exec bin/qingyu-api
